import pandas as pd
import numpy as np

def time_series_filling():
    # Create time series with missing values
    dates = pd.date_range('2024-01-01', periods=10, freq='D')
    df = pd.DataFrame({
        'temperature': [20.5, np.nan, np.nan, 22.1, np.nan, 23.5, np.nan, np.nan, np.nan, 25.0],
        'humidity': [65, 68, np.nan, np.nan, 72, np.nan, 70, np.nan, 75, 73]
    }, index=dates)
    
    print("Original time series:")
    print(df)
    
    # Forward fill
    df_ffill = df.ffill()
    print("\nForward Fill (ffill):")
    print(df_ffill)
    
    # Backward fill
    df_bfill = df.bfill()
    print("\nBackward Fill (bfill):")
    print(df_bfill)
    
    # Forward fill with limit
    df_ffill_limited = df.ffill(limit=2)
    print("\nForward Fill (limit=2):")
    print(df_ffill_limited)
    
    # Combined: ffill then bfill for remaining
    df_combined = df.ffill().bfill()
    print("\nCombined (ffill then bfill):")
    print(df_combined)

time_series_filling()
